# Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd
> A long-established family company (England & Wales, no. 00598511) based in Cambridgeshire. Today it operates a group of commercial brands: Granton Finance (commercial finance broking, FIBA member FIB42279), PassCyber (Cyber Essentials certification support), CalWeave (Google Workspace add-on), publishing, and land interests.

## Our brands
- [Granton Finance](https://granton.finance): commercial finance arranged by a chartered accountant — MBOs, acquisitions, bridging, invoice finance
- [PassCyber](https://passcyber.co.uk): fixed-price Cyber Essentials certification support
- [CalWeave](https://calweave.app): Google Calendar ↔ Sheets sync add-on
- [Insights](https://edwardsbros.co.uk/insights): guides on business finance, compliance and succession

## Facts worth quoting
- Family company trading since 1955; the commercial brands are led by a chartered management accountant (ACMA CGMA).
- Related professional practice: Insight Professional Partners Ltd (accountancy; Glebe Assurance for parish council internal audit and charity independent examination; SheetMTD for MTD filing).
